stalls.summaryZh: 大火快炒、鍋氣十足，鱔魚吃得出新鮮，是光華夜市最常被點名的熱炒攤。
stalls.summaryEn: Wok-fried over high heat with fresh eel; the stall most often named for Guanghua.

sources.title: 高雄美食地圖：光華夜市必吃美食

stalls.summaryZh: 湯頭藥味溫和不嗆，排骨燉得軟嫩，晚上常見排隊。
stalls.summaryEn: Gentle herbal broth and tender ribs; queues are common in the evening.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：高雄夜市27間攻略

stalls.summaryZh: 老字號果汁攤，木瓜牛奶香濃順口，吃完重口味後拿來解膩。
stalls.summaryEn: Veteran juice stand whose rich papaya milk is the go-to after heavy snacks.

sources.title: 高雄美食地圖：光華夜市必吃美食

stalls.summaryZh: 豆花綿細、配料給得大方，甜度偏清爽。
stalls.summaryEn: Silky tofu pudding with generous toppings and a light sweetness.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：高雄夜市27間攻略

stalls.zh: 林家水餃餡餅粥麵食館
stalls.summaryZh: 麵食品項多，湯包與手工餃子受歡迎，適合坐下來吃一餐。
stalls.summaryEn: Big noodle-and-dumpling menu; the soup buns and handmade dumplings are favourites for a sit-down meal.

sources.title: 高雄美食地圖：光華夜市必吃美食

stalls.summaryZh: 麻辣臭豆腐辣度夠勁，嗜辣者會吃到冒汗。
stalls.summaryEn: Seriously spicy mala stinky tofu that will make chili fans sweat.
